subject.title: fix(scripts): warn when postinstall detects running gateway with stale module imports

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled-plugin postinstall loopback probe plus `OPENCLAW_DISABLE_POSTINSTALL_RESTART_WARNING` as an advisory stale-gateway warning layer?
rationale: The code is mechanically coherent, but install-time network probing, a new env opt-out, and overlap with update-CLI warning work are operator-experience and product-boundary choices.

options.title: Accept Postinstall Advisory
options.body: Merge this as a warning-only mitigation after maintainer review, with the canonical stale-gateway issue left open for full recovery behavior.

options.title: Require Full Gateway Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted output from a real package update or rollback with an already-running gateway before accepting the postinstall probe.

options.title: Pause For One Recovery Layer
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want update CLI output or runtime stale-import handling to be the only warning and recovery boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept Postinstall Advisory
recommendation.body: Merge this as a warning-only mitigation after maintainer review, with the canonical stale-gateway issue left open for full recovery behavior.
